records.source: Oh, you want to go to the movies? Sounds pretty good. I'll meet you there.$h
records.translation: 喔，你想去看電影？聽起來挺不錯。我們在那裡碰面。$h

records.source: Oh, you want to see a show, huh? Buy me a snack and it's a deal, hehe...$h#$e#I'll meet you there.
records.translation: 喔，你想看場電影，對吧？買份點心給我就成交，嘿嘿……$h#$e#我們在那裡碰面。

records.source: Yes, my dear, I'd love to see a movie with you! I'll meet you at the theater.
records.translation: 當然，親愛的，我很樂意和你看電影！電影院見。

records.source: Movie tickets? Well... yes, I'd love to go with you!$h#$e#It's good to do things like this, I don't want married life to get boring for you!
records.translation: 電影票？嗯……好啊，我很樂意和你一起去！$h#$e#偶爾做這種事很好，我不希望婚後生活讓你覺得無聊！

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'm out of the house today for my weekly aerobics club... Sorry! *beep*
records.translation: 嘿，我是羅賓。今天出門參加每週一次的有氧運動社團……抱歉！*嗶聲*

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'll be out of the house until tomorrow finishing up a project. *beep*
records.translation: 嘿，我是羅賓。我要在外面完成一項工程，明天才會回家。*嗶聲*

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'll be busy for the next few days working on a project. *beep*
records.translation: 嘿，我是羅賓。接下來幾天會忙著進行一項工程。*嗶聲*

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'm taking the day off today. Sorry for the inconvenience! *beep*
records.translation: 嘿，我是羅賓。今天休假一天。造成不便，敬請見諒！*嗶聲*

records.source: Hello? Hey! Yes, I'm currently open for business... please swing by before 5PM if you need anything! *click* $h
records.translation: 喂？嘿！對，我現在正在營業……如果有任何需要，請在下午五點前過來！*喀嚓* $h

records.source: Hello? Oh, hi @! *BANG*... Um, one sec... (Muffled Voice: Honey, could you close the door? I'm trying to run a business here.)... Sorry! Yes, I'm open until 5pm today. See you later! *click*
records.translation: 喂？喔，嗨，@！*砰*……嗯，等一下……（模糊的聲音：親愛的，可以把門關上嗎？我正在這裡做生意。）……抱歉！對，今天營業到下午五點。待會兒見！*喀嚓*

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. My business hours are from 9AM to 5PM. Please come by then if you need anything! *beep*
records.translation: 嘿，我是羅賓。營業時間是上午九點到下午五點。如果有任何需要，請在這段時間過來！*嗶聲*

records.source: Hello? Oh, hey, @. Yup, I'm open for business until 4PM. Er... Okay. Goodbye. *click*
records.translation: 喂？喔，嘿，@。對，我營業到下午四點。呃……好。再見。*喀嚓*

records.source: Hello? Yes, yes, I'm open until 4pm. Gotta go. *click*^Hello? Oh... @... Your voice sounds really nice over the phone... Uh... Okay. Understood. I'm open until 4pm. *slam*$4
records.translation: 喂？對、對，營業到下午四點。我得掛了。*喀嚓*^喂？喔……@……你的聲音在電話裡聽起來真好聽……呃……好。明白了。我營業到下午四點。*猛然掛斷*$4

records.source: You've reached Clint's answering machine. I'm not available right now... My business hours are from 9AM to 4PM. *beep*
records.translation: 這裡是克林特的答錄機。我現在無法接聽……營業時間是上午九點到下午四點。*嗶聲*

records.source: Hey, this is Clint. I'm taking the day off today. *beep*
records.translation: 嘿，我是克林特。今天休假一天。*嗶聲*

records.source: Hey... Your tool will be ready for pickup tomorrow. I gotta get back to work now. *clank* *clank* *click*
records.translation: 嘿……你的工具明天就能取回。我現在得繼續工作了。*鏗鏘* *鏗鏘* *喀嚓*

records.source: Hello? Yes? Your tool still needs a few more days of work. Check back with me later. *click*
records.translation: 喂？怎麼了？你的工具還需要幾天才能完成。稍後再來問我。*喀嚓*

records.source: (Hang up)
records.translation: （掛斷）

records.source: Check house upgrade cost
records.translation: 查詢房屋升級費用

records.source: Check building upgrade costs
records.translation: 查詢建築升級費用

records.source: Check tool upgrade costs
records.translation: 查詢工具升級費用

records.source: Please select a number:
records.translation: 請選擇號碼：

records.source: Please make a selection:
records.translation: 請選擇：

records.source: Hello? Hi @! Yes... today's special is: '{0}'! We're open right now, so feel free to come on in for a taste. *click*
records.translation: 喂？嗨，@！對……今天的特餐是：「{0}」！我們現在正在營業，隨時歡迎來品嘗。*喀嚓*

records.source: (You hear slurping and chewing sounds on the other end...)#$b#*gulp* ... Uh.. Oh! Well, hello! Hahah... pardon me, I was just tasting today's special, '{0}'. It's delicious. Yes... Yes we're open right now. Come by if you want a taste! *click*
records.translation: （電話另一端傳來吸食和咀嚼聲……）#$b#*吞嚥*……呃……喔！你好！哈哈……失禮了，我剛才正在品嘗今天的特餐「{0}」。非常美味。對……對，我們現在正在營業。想嘗嘗就過來吧！*喀嚓*

records.source: Hello, this is Gus from the Stardrop Saloon. We're currently closed, but please come by later if you'd like to try our daily special, '{0}'! *beep*
records.translation: 你好，我是星之果實酒館的格斯。我們目前已打烊，但如果想品嘗今日特餐「{0}」，請稍後再來！*嗶聲*

records.source: Hello, this is Gus from the Stardrop Saloon. We're closed for the day. *beep*
records.translation: 你好，我是星之果實酒館的格斯。我們今天暫停營業。*嗶聲*

records.source: Pierre's General Store! Oh, hello, @! Yes, I'm open until 5pm today. Please come by for great deals on seeds and produce! Goodbye. *click*
records.translation: 皮埃爾雜貨店！喔，你好，@！對，今天營業到下午五點。歡迎前來選購價格實惠的種子和農產品！再見。*喀嚓*

records.source: Abigail! Your guinea pig is loose again! Come here *right now* and take care of this! $3#$b#Oh! Uh... Hello? Thank you for calling. Y... Yes, we're open until 5PM. Goodbye. *click*$4
records.translation: 阿比蓋爾！你的天竺鼠又跑出來了！*立刻*過來處理！$3#$b#喔！呃……喂？感謝來電。對……對，我們營業到下午五點。再見。*喀嚓*$4

records.source: Thank you for calling Pierre's General Store. We're closed at the moment, but our hours are 9AM to 5PM. See you then! *beep*
records.translation: 感謝致電皮埃爾雜貨店。我們目前已打烊，營業時間是上午九點到下午五點。到時見！*嗶聲*

records.source: Thank you for calling Pierre's General Store. We're closed today in observance of the festival. *beep*
records.translation: 感謝致電皮埃爾雜貨店。今天為配合節慶暫停營業。*嗶聲*

records.source: Check store inventory
records.translation: 查詢商店庫存

records.source: Hello? Hi @! Yup, we're open right now. Hope to see you soon! *click*$h
records.translation: 喂？嗨，@！對，我們現在正在營業。希望很快見到你！*喀嚓*$h

records.source: Hello, this is Gus from the Stardrop Saloon. We're currently closed. Please stop in between 12PM and 12AM if you'd like some of our delicious food and drink. *beep*
records.translation: 你好，我是星之果實酒館的格斯。我們目前已打烊。如果想享用美味的餐飲，請在中午十二點到午夜十二點之間前來。*嗶聲*

records.source: Hello? Oh, hi @! Yes, my shop is open until 4:00 PM today. Hope to see you soon! *click*
records.translation: 喂？喔，嗨，@！對，我的商店今天營業到下午四點。希望很快見到你！*喀嚓*

records.source: Lew...? Hah... Heyyy! Yup, I'm open right now. *bahhh*. That sound? Oh, it's one of my goats. Please come by if you need anything! *click* $4
records.translation: 路易……？哈……嘿！對，我現在正在營業。*咩*。那個聲音？喔，是我的一隻山羊。如果有任何需要，請過來！*喀嚓* $4

records.source: Hello, you've reached Marnie's Ranch. My business hours are from 9AM to 4PM. Please come visit me then. *beep*
records.translation: 你好，這裡是瑪妮牧場。營業時間是上午九點到下午四點。請在這段時間來訪。*嗶聲*

records.source: Hello, you've reached Marnie's Ranch. My shop is closed today.
records.translation: 你好，這裡是瑪妮牧場。我的商店今天公休。

records.source: Check livestock prices
records.translation: 查詢牲畜價格

records.source: Hello?#$b#Um... Uhhh... This is Vincent.$3#$b#... $3#$b#Um... Do you have any piggies on your farm?$h#$b#...$3#$b#Okay I gotta go! *click* $3
records.translation: 喂？#$b#嗯……呃……我是文森特。$3#$b#……$3#$b#嗯……你的農場有小豬嗎？$h#$b#……$3#$b#好，我得掛了！*喀嚓* $3

records.source: You hear a robotic voice on the other end. # Congratulations. . . You. Have. A. 10,000g. JOJA. Rebate. Waiting. For. You. . . Please. Mail. Your. Credit. Card. Number. To. 133. N. Gunger St. Zuzu. City. To. Receive. Your. Rebate. . . *CLICK*
records.translation: 電話另一端傳來機器人的聲音。#恭喜。你。有。一筆。10,000g。JOJA。回饋金。等待。領取。請。將。信用卡。號碼。寄到。祖祖市。北岡格街。133 號。以。領取。回饋金。*喀嚓*

records.source: Hey, @. It's me, Pierre. #$b#How are you doing? Good? That's good.#$b#Well, I just wanted to say that I appreciate your business. And I'd like to remind you that Pierre's General Store carries *the finest* seeds and produce anywhere.#$b#I hope to see you in the store very soon. Bye! *click*
records.translation: 嘿，@。我是皮埃爾。#$b#最近如何？很好？那就好。#$b#嗯，我只是想說，感謝你光顧本店。也想提醒你，皮埃爾雜貨店販售各地*最優質的*種子和農產品。#$b#希望很快能在店裡見到你。再見！*喀嚓*

records.source: You hear a squeaky voice on the other end: # Heyo poke! Me sell gud hats. Please come, n' bring coines, poke. Me like coines. *click*
records.translation: 電話另一端傳來尖細的聲音：#嘿喲，夥伴！俺賣好帽帽。快來，帶錢錢，夥伴。俺喜歡錢錢。*喀嚓*

records.source: It's a pre-recorded message in a foreign language. You can't understand it at all.
records.translation: 這是一段外語預錄訊息。你完全聽不懂。

records.source: *sniff* *sniff*$2#$b#HoOoOoOoOoO!$3#$b#... Is that you? #$b# *grunt*... I have some of that good sauce still, friend.#$b#It's making me very, very happy. *snort*$1#$b#Just want to thank you... bye bye friend. *click*
records.translation: *嗅嗅* *嗅嗅*$2#$b#吼喔喔喔喔！$3#$b#……是你嗎？#$b#*低吼*……我還留著一些那種美味醬汁，朋友。#$b#它讓我非常、非常開心。*噴鼻息*$1#$b#只是想謝謝你……再見，朋友。*喀嚓*

records.source: Hey, @. #$b#I just wanted to check up on you and see if %farm Farm is doing well.#$b#$y 'How's everything going?_Good! I really feel at home here._Good to hear. *I think I can speak for everyone in saying that we really value your presence in the community.*Your Grandfather would be really proud of what you've accomplished. *Well, I'll let you get back to your work. Goodbye!_Good! The farm is very productive._Good to hear! *Your farm has really boosted the local economy, which is good for everyone. We all appreciate your hard work! *I think it's safe to say that your Grandfather would be really proud of what you've accomplished.*Well, I'll let you get back to your work. Goodbye!_Not so good..._Oh... I'm sorry to hear that. $s*Uh... Keep working hard and I'm sure things will improve... *Well... I'll let you get back to it, then... Okay? Talk to you later. Bye. $s_I know your secret, Lewis._What's that? I think the line cut out... I can't hear a thing. Alright, well I guess I'll hang up then. Bye.$3'
records.translation: 嘿，@。#$b#我只是想問候一下，看看%farm農場經營得好不好。#$b#$y '一切進展如何？_很好！我真的覺得這裡像家。_很高興聽你這麼說。*我想自己可以代表大家說，我們非常珍惜你在這個社區的存在。*你的祖父一定會為你的成就深感驕傲。*好吧，我讓你繼續工作。再見！_很好！農場生產力很高。_很高興聽你這麼說！*你的農場大大促進了當地經濟，對所有人都有好處。我們都很感謝你的努力！*可以肯定地說，你的祖父一定會為你的成就深感驕傲。*好吧，我讓你繼續工作。再見！_不太好……_喔……聽到這個消息，我很遺憾。$s*呃……繼續努力，我相信情況會改善……*嗯……那我讓你繼續忙了……好嗎？下次再聊。再見。$s_我知道你的祕密，路易斯。_什麼？電話好像斷線了……我什麼也聽不見。好吧，看來只能掛斷了。再見。$3'

records.source: You place the receiver to your ear, and are met with a roiling, abrasive static. # But wait... beneath it all, you can make out something else... an otherworldly voice... # 'Y-O-U H-A-V-E F-O-R-S-A-K-E-N U-S'
records.translation: 你把話筒湊到耳邊，聽見翻湧而刺耳的雜訊。#但等等……在所有雜音之下，還能辨認出另一種聲音……來自異世界的聲音……#「你—拋—棄—了—我—們」

records.source: Hey... I was just thinking about that time, back on the island... Do you remember?
records.translation: 嘿……我剛才想起在島上的那段時光……你記得嗎？

records.source: Remind me
records.translation: 提醒我

records.source: I'm busy
records.translation: 我很忙

records.source: When we talked about your home?
records.translation: 我們談到你的家時？

records.source: When we talked about birds?
records.translation: 我們談到鳥兒時？

records.source: When I decided to move?
records.translation: 我決定搬家時？

records.source: Oh, wow! It's my old stock list! I've been searching everywhere for this thing.$h#$b#Let me see... yup! It's all still here.#$b#With these order codes, I can expand my stock to include seeds from all seasons, year round!#$b#Thanks so much for bringing this back to me, @.$h
records.translation: 喔，哇！這是我的舊庫存清單！我找遍了各個地方。$h#$b#讓我看看……對！內容全都還在。#$b#有了這些訂貨代碼，我就能擴充庫存，全年販售所有季節的種子！#$b#非常感謝你把它帶回來給我，@。$h

records.source: Marlon speaking... Did you lose something in the mines again? Yes, yes... I'm willing to fetch it... for a price.
records.translation: 我是馬龍……你又在礦井裡弄丟東西了嗎？好、好……我願意去取回來……只要付錢。

records.source: Hello?... Yep, I'm going to fetch your item tonight. You can relax. No need to keep calling! *click*
records.translation: 喂？……對，今晚我會去取回你的物品。你可以放心。不用一直打電話！*喀嚓*

records.source: What's that? You haven't lost anything in the mines? Okay. Sounds like you don't need my help, then. Take care. *click*
records.translation: 什麼？你沒有在礦井裡弄丟任何東西？好吧。聽起來不需要我的幫助。保重。*喀嚓*
